descriptor: Night-sky arcade with polished classic games

voice.summary: A friendly arcade attendant under neon: encouraging, quick and fond of high scores. Copy is punchy and games-first, with a little starry wonder.
dos: Use arcade verbs like launch, smash and clear
Show lives and scores as plain numbers
Celebrate in one line then get back to the game

taglines: Break the sky, one brick at a time
One more round under the stars
boilerplate: Starlight Arcade is an invented arcade of polished browser games, led by Brick Breaker, with power-ups, three levels and a saved high score.

microcopy.success: New high score. Look at you
microcopy.empty: No high score yet. Set the first

logo.note: A spark reads as a star or a ball strike, fitting the starlit arcade and the glowing ball.
